hero.description: Tarongea was born from the need to modernize a family business dedicated to Valencian oranges without losing its traditional essence. The project develops a visual identity and communication strategy capable of bringing the values of closeness, authenticity, and locally grown products into a contemporary context.

context.title: CONTEXT
context.text: The Valencian agricultural sector is saturated with generic, undifferentiated products. Our goal is to transform a traditional family business into a brand with its own distinct identity.

cards.title: Generic product
cards.text: Difficulty standing out in a saturated market.

cards.title: Family business
cards.text: More than 50 years of tradition and local sales.

cards.title: Oportunity
cards.text: Create an emotional, approachable, and contemporary brand.

strategy.title: STRATEGY
strategy.text: A strategy based on closeness, authenticity, and the value of locally grown Valencian products.

identity.title: IDENTITY
identity.text: We created a fresh, natural, and contemporary visual identity, inspired by the organic shapes of leaves and fruit, as well as the vibrant colors of the Mediterranean.

digital.title: DIGITAL
digital.text: We designed a digital experience focused on clarity, closeness, and the authenticity of the brand. The website brings the values of locally grown Valencian products into a contemporary environment, improving direct communication with customers and strengthening Tarongea’s visual identity in the digital space.

communication.title: MEDIA
communication.text: Vertical content designed for digital platforms, live event promotion, and community engagement through dynamic motorsport communication.

hero.description: Every designer needs to identify with a brand that supports them and makes their work recognizable — a personal signature aligned with their style, vision, and way of understanding the world of design. This is how Nacca Design was born, or in other words: my own personal brand.

context.title: CONTEXT
context.text: In an increasingly saturated creative environment, Nacca Design emerges as a pursuit of differentiation and visual coherence. The project proposes a graphic system capable of unifying identity, communication, and art direction through a clean, modular, and recognizable visual language.

cards.title: Personal Brand
cards.text: Build a unique identity capable of reflecting visual criteria and personality.

cards.title: Modular System
cards.text: Develop a flexible graphic language adaptable across multiple platforms and formats.

cards.title: Minimalism
cards.text: Visual synthesis based on geometry, structure, and compositional clarity.

identity.title: IDENTITY
identity.text: The identity of Nacca Design is built around a modular symbol system inspired by structure, rhythm, and geometric reduction. Through repetition, proportion, and minimalism, the visual language creates a flexible and recognizable graphic system adaptable across digital and physical applications. A restrained, material-inspired color palette reinforces the balance between precision, functionality, and contemporary aesthetics throughout the entire identity.

digital.title: DIGITAL
digital.text: The digital experience translates the visual identity of Nacca Design into a clean and structured interface where typography, composition, and motion reinforce the modular nature of the brand. Minimal layouts, restrained interactions, and a neutral visual environment create a contemporary platform focused on clarity, usability, and visual consistency.

hero.description: LaCueva Racing is a SimRacing community focused on competitive virtual motorsport experiences and digital racing events. Developed during the rise of online communities in 2020, the project required a scalable visual identity system.

context.title: CONTEXT
context.text: Born during the global lockdown in 2020, LaCueva Racing emerged as a virtual motorsport community focused on competitive SimRacing experiences. As the project evolved, the brand required a scalable visual identity capable of supporting championships, live events, digital communication, and social media content across multiple racing platforms.

cards.title: Competitive Community
cards.text: Virtual racing events built around competition and community.

cards.title: Digital Motorsport
cards.text: Broadcast graphics and content for SimRacing championships.

cards.title: Scalable Identity
cards.text: A flexible visual system inspired by motorsport culture.

strategy.title: STRATEGY
strategy.text: A strategy focused on competition, community, and digital motorsport culture. The visual system was designed to create a recognizable identity capable of supporting events, broadcasts, and online communication across multiple platforms.

identity.title: IDENTITY
identity.text: The identity system combines bold typography, angular geometries, and high-contrast compositions inspired by motorsport graphics and broadcast communication. Dynamic layouts, repetitive patterns, and vibrant orange accents reinforce the competitive and energetic nature of the brand across digital and promotional applications.

videoGrid.title: MOTION GRAPHICS
videoGrid.text: Animated broadcast graphics and visual pieces designed to reinforce the competitive identity of the community across streams, events, and digital content.

communication.title: MEDIA
communication.text: Content designed for digital platforms, event promotion, and community engagement through dynamic motorsport communication.

hero.description: NutriMarietas is a nutrition and wellness brand built around a close, natural, and recognizable visual identity. The project aims to communicate healthy habits and trust through a fresh, dynamic, and accessible communication style for all audiences.

context.title: CONTEXT
context.text: The nutrition and wellness sector is saturated with generic and highly technical communication styles that often feel distant or impersonal. NutriMarietas was created to build a fresh, approachable, and recognizable brand identity capable of connecting with people through clear communication, healthy lifestyle values, and a friendly visual language.

cards.title: Wellness Brand
cards.text: A fresh identity focused on nutrition and healthy habits.

cards.title: Approachable Communication
cards.text: Friendly and accessible visual language for all audiences.

cards.title: Recognizable System
cards.text: A flexible identity built around organic shapes and color.

strategy.title: STRATEGY
strategy.text: A strategy focused on clarity, closeness, and positive communication. The visual system was designed to create a fresh and approachable identity capable of connecting nutrition and wellness through a recognizable and flexible graphic language.

identity.title: IDENTITY
identity.text: The visual identity combines organic shapes, vibrant colors, and approachable graphic elements to create a fresh and recognizable brand system. Inspired by concepts of wellness, balance, and natural nutrition, the identity uses a friendly visual language capable of adapting consistently across both digital and physical communication materials.

hero.description: A packaging design project developed for the LOU hanger family, focused on elevating the product experience through structure, presentation, and visual communication. Inspired by Nordic and Mediterranean design principles, the proposal combines functionality, simplicity, and attention to detail.

context.title: CONTEXT
context.text: The project was developed as a packaging proposal for the LOU hanger family, aiming to improve both product presentation and user experience. The challenge focused on creating a functional and visually refined solution aligned with contemporary furniture and interior design aesthetics.

cards.title: Packaging System
cards.text: A functional solution designed for the LOU hanger collection.

cards.title: Product Experience
cards.text: Focused on presentation, usability, and visual clarity.

cards.title: Minimal Aesthetics
cards.text: Inspired by contemporary furniture and editorial design.

strategy.title: STRATEGY
strategy.text: The strategy was based on simplifying the packaging experience while maximizing product perception. Structural efficiency, clean graphics, and modular organization were combined to create a system that felt both functional and carefully crafted, reinforcing the premium and contemporary character of the LOU collection.

identity.title: IDENTITY
identity.text: The identity of LOU is built around simplicity, geometry, and subtle visual meaning. The logo takes inspiration from the lower structure of the hanger collection itself, where each support shape naturally forms the letters L, O, and U. Combined with clean typography and minimalist composition, the system reflects the functional and contemporary character of the project.
